baseline_source: Phase 42 calibrated from Phase 41/pre-Phase 42 local benchmark runs, 2026-05-07

threshold_policy.calibration: loose calibrated ceilings, roughly 2x-3x observed local medians depending on row volatility
threshold_policy.intent: catch material accidental regressions before broadening emulator scope

notes: Local synthetic regression guard only; not a hardware, Android-device, thermal, battery, or production-readiness claim.
Thresholds are calibrated but intentionally tolerant to catch material slowdowns while allowing workstation noise.
